name: Legal Services Management
author: Mati Ullah

sections.description:
Manage legal ops with ease. Organize articles, display testimonials. Supports Clients & Advocates. Scalable for law firms, pros.
Effortlessly manage legal operations with the Legal Services Management Plugin. Create and organize articles by category to keep users informed on legal topics, and showcase client testimonials to build trust. The plugin supports two primary roles—Clients and Advocates—offering tailored features for each. Designed with scalability in mind, this plugin sets the foundation for advanced legal service functionalities in future updates. Ideal for law firms, legal professionals, and advocacy platforms.

This plugin provides the following shortcodes:

  • [sam_team] – Displays a list of advocates.
  • [sam_services] – Outputs a services grid or box.
  • [sam_slider] – Shows a testimonial slider.
  • [sam_faqs] – Displays a list of frequently asked questions.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 4.5 or greater
  • PHP version 5.2.4 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater

Recommended Requirements

  • PHP version 8.1 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater

Installation

  1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
